review_cost.rationale: Approve after a round of small, local fixes — nothing structural blocks merge. The index/cache design is worth a design comment but doesn't require rework at this size.

findings.issue: getIndex() permanently caches a rejected buildIndex() promise; a single transient API failure at first request bricks every page with 500s until the process restarts (per-URL cache entries self-heal at api.js:18, but the index never does).
findings.suggestion: Reset the memo on failure: buildIndex().catch((e) => { indexPromise = null; throw e; }) or equivalent, so the next request retries.

findings.issue: Active search uses hx-trigger debounce but no hx-sync, so a request issued while another is in flight lets the last-completed response win the swap, showing stale results and pushing a stale URL.
findings.suggestion: Add hx-sync="this:replace" to the filter form, as the htmx docs recommend for active search.

findings.issue: app.onError returns the 'Not found' page body with status 500, so server errors render as 404s to users and to assistive tech.
findings.suggestion: Render a distinct error page (e.g. h1 'Something went wrong') for 500s.

findings.issue: Latest-English-flavor-text and genus logic re-implemented inline, duplicating latestEnglishFlavor (api.js:46) and leaving exported englishGenus (api.js:42) dead — two sources of truth for the same domain rule.
findings.suggestion: Import latestEnglishFlavor/englishGenus in views.js and delete the inline copies.

findings.issue: Three hand-registered serveStatic routes with cwd-relative paths; running the server from another directory silently 404s all assets.
findings.suggestion: Use one app.use('/public/*', serveStatic({ root: ... })) resolved via import.meta.url, or at minimum derive paths from the module location.

findings.issue: PAGE_SIZE, used for slicing in the route (app.js:56), is defined and re-exported from the views module.
findings.suggestion: Move the constant into app.js (or a config module) and pass it into the view.

findings.issue: apiFetch has no timeout, so a hung upstream request hangs the page response indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetch with AbortSignal.timeout(...) (e.g. 10s) so failures surface to onError quickly.

findings.issue: The cache Map has no TTL or eviction and lives for the process lifetime; fine for a fixed dataset but silently conflicts with the spec's 'treat the API as live' stance over long uptimes.
findings.suggestion: Note the assumption in a comment, or add a simple TTL so long-lived processes pick up API changes eventually.

findings.issue: Each sort click on a moves table re-runs loadPokemonPageData + buildMovesData (full species, pokemon, all move records, all methods) just to render one table.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable at this size, but cache the built movesData per (species, game) or slice buildMovesData so the fragment endpoint only computes the requested method.

findings.issue: The typeEn fallback closure is duplicated verbatim at views.js:186, 349, 379 and 426.
findings.suggestion: Hoist it to a single exported helper (e.g. makeTypeEn(index)) next to the other name helpers.

summary: A clean, current-stack Hono 4 + htmx 2 SSR app that uses the frameworks almost exactly as documented: hono/html templates, HX-Request fragment endpoints, debounced/pushed-URL filtering, and careful 404 and escaping behavior. The main merge blocker is a permanently-cached rejected index promise that makes the whole app unrecoverable after one boot-time API hiccup; the rest are nits (missing hx-sync on search, a 500 that renders as the 404 page, and a handful of duplicated helpers in an over-broad api.js). I'd merge after one small round of fixes.
